LOGICAL_CONFIGIO_HALF.statement: Configio LoHi selects which byte of the logical Fortna data-table word a CardGetByte result occupies.
LOGICAL_CONFIGIO_HALF.High: one bank byte shifted << 8 → logical bits 8..15 (mask 0xFF00)
LOGICAL_CONFIGIO_HALF.does_not_prove: PHYSICAL_MODULE_INSTANCE ownership of the High bank

PHYSICAL_MODULE_INSTANCE.statement: Which EIP module owns Configio.Bank as an RTA byte index requires CardGetByte/RTA driver implementation.
PHYSICAL_MODULE_INSTANCE.available: extern int CardGetByte(int a, int indx, unsigned *value); in fplus.c — implementation NOT present in available source dump
call_sites: also ac51_getbank / omux_read / fio_get paths for other interfaces

file_evidence.excerpt_summary: CardGetByte(..., Configio_Bank(a), &val); switch Configio_LoHi: case 0 Low masks 0x00FF; case 1 High does val<<=8 and masks 0xFF00; writes FORTNADT_Bits_On_Off(Octal_Word).
extern CardGetByte / CardPutByte — definition not in this tree

note: LOGICAL Low/High packing is proven from Fortna source. PHYSICAL bank→module byte-span still needs RTA/CardGetByte body or equivalent driver source.
